reason: One sharing-authority module replaces repeated legacy-only ownership/locking queries for invitations, member creation/lifecycle and listing. The existing permission snapshots, migration freeze guard, identity/seat schema, transactional policy outbox and native join proof/member checks remain canonical. Four internal declarations expose that shared authority and manager boundary; ten relative imports wire existing mechanisms. No new endpoint, credential, role state, schema or policy operation. Runtime additions are real-crypto test fixtures only.
